description: A binding relationship between a small-molecule compound and a Pfam protein-domain family, supported by contact observed in Protein Data Bank crystal structures.

source_contributions.scope: Ligand–Pfam domain-family contacts observed in PDB structures, limited to compounds and protein domains represented in SPOKE. Ligand coverage is partial.
source_contributions.description: ProtCID (Protein Common Interface Database; Dunbrack lab) summarizes structurally observed ligand–domain contacts. Each relationship records the existence of contact for a compound–domain-family pair; source statistics such as the number of PDB entries are not included.
